result.summary: The page is largely usable, but there are a few visual/content polish issues: horizontal content is hard-clipped at the right edge, and one promo badge shows a meaningless “-0%” value.

issues.description: Horizontally scrolling items are cut off abruptly at the right edge, including a category chip and the “Trattoria Piccol…” restaurant card/name.
issues.suggestion: Add edge fade/gradient, more right padding, or snap/peek spacing so clipped carousel items look intentional and text remains readable.

issues.description: The lower “Popular right now” card shows a “-0%” badge, which is meaningless and looks like a formatting/data error.
issues.suggestion: Hide the badge when discount is 0%, or display a valid positive discount only.

issues.description: Small delivery/time metadata under restaurant cards uses light gray text that may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase contrast of secondary text or use a darker gray while preserving hierarchy.
